description.value: Soupa Cafe is a Victoria institution specializing in fresh, daily-made soups and sandwiches crafted from local ingredients, with a rotating weekly special alongside six permanent classics. The menu leans heavily toward inclusive eating — at least three vegan soups are offered every day, and many dishes are gluten-free. Dine-in tables are available and described as accessible to all guests, making it a comfortable mid-ride stop for cyclists looking for a nourishing, quick meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Soupa Cafe is an active soup and sandwich restaurant in Victoria with online ordering, third-party delivery partnerships, and explicit dine-in seating. The FAQ page confirms vegan (at least 3 daily), vegetarian, and gluten-free options across the menu. No bike infrastructure, washroom details, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging are mentioned anywhere on the site; the OSM record also provides no such tags. The full street address is absent from both OSM (only unit 145) and the scraped website content.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Soupa Cafe is a legitimate, active food business with a strong fit for cycling tourism: a nourishing hot-meal stop with vegan and GF options, dine-in seating, and online ordering. The listing would benefit from a confirmed street address and bike parking details.
